'''Holographic statues''' were exotic technology employed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. They were larger than in real life, and could appear to different people at different locations. Daiman used one to track [[Kerra Holt]]'s progress on [[Tergamenion]] and then to communicate with her, to tell her to infiltrate [[Odion]]'s realm.
